newsitem.title: UK: LPC-British Gas sets 1.0 bln stg loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-British Gas sets 1.0 bln stg loan.

text.p: LONDON, Dec 5 (LPC) - British Gas have signed a 1.0 billion stg credit facility to support its demerger plans, according to a British Gas spokesman.
BZW, Chase Investment Bank and NatWest Markets are arranging the loan, which is fully underwritten and was signed December 3.

The revolving credit will form the core working capital for Centrica, currently known as British Gas Energy and slated for demerger in February. The 3.5-year loan will be active from the date of the demerger.
General syndication is planned for 1997. Centrica will include the UK gas sales and trading, services and retail businesses of British Gas, along with Morecambe North and South gas fields.
